releaseNotes: NEW APP IDENTITY: the app now lives under the Ophelia brand package (com.ophelia.appcloner) instead of the old internal one. IMPORTANT: install this update, then uninstall the old 'Clone by Ophelia' from your launcher — both will coexist until you remove the old one. Your clones are not affected
The 'Developed by Deadlock Studio' credit on clone loading screens is now ~3x bigger — a proper two-line studio lockup you can actually read

Cloning screen now warns you upfront when an app's main login is Google sign-in / passkeys (YouTube, Gmail…) and shows which login actually works inside clones (Discord/WhatsApp/Telegram QR login, email+password)
Help section expanded: per-app guidance for signing in to clones without Google
Pic Hider v1.2.0 in the Products tab: photo import and custom-icon crashes fixed (root-caused), fingerprint unlock now works on Class-2 face/fingerprint sensors, all-new professional PIN screens
